title: This Month's figure and trend line both include today's sales
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as {User-A} (for example Admin ShopView), whose role has the Reports permission, at location {Location-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST Today Sales 14 Oct A).
  • Your browser window is at least 1024 pixels wide at 100% zoom (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
  • {Location-A} is a fresh location made for this run: before today nothing was invoiced or credited there.
  • Today is not the 1st of the month.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S490-1310) for customer {Customer-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST Today Sales Fleet) was invoiced today at {Location-A}, with no discount and a Subtotal of (for example) $250.00 (2.50 hours at $100.00 an hour).
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top bar (the Revenue tile opens on This Month).
  2. Read the Revenue headline.
  3. Look at the Revenue trend line.
  4. Hover the right-hand end of the trend line and read the date and value shown, if any.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: The Revenue headline equals {Work-order-1}'s invoice Subtotal (for example $250.00): the This Month figure runs from the 1st of the month up to and including today.
  • Step 3: A trend line is drawn, not the dashed empty-chart outline. It runs flat along the bottom for the earlier days of this month, which had no sales, and rises at its right-hand end, today, the only day with sales.
  • Step 4: The last point is today and reads the same amount as the headline (for example $250.00). If hovering shows no value, write "point values not checked by hand" in the result comment; step 3 still decides pass or fail.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9579 (Story 7, Per-Tile Date Ranges), with SV-9576 (Story 4); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850, version 48 (14 Oct 2026, 17:09 UTC, Chris Ward), S7-E1, S4-R2 and S4-E3 (since version 42), S4-R11a (added in version 43 on 9 Oct 2026) and S4-R11b (added in version 45 on 14 Oct 2026 (15:06 UTC) by Chris Ward, from Chris Ward's answer 1 of 14 Oct 2026 to our question sheet); read 14 Oct 2026. Design canvas (claude.ai/artifact/Wae9DFQ8PJQBy8mbLsL5ge) board 01_Opens_After, used for on-screen labels only. Source-verified 14 October 2026. This version of the case has not yet been checked against a build (the previous version was last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S7-E1: “If the selected range has not finished, the tile's headline and sparkline both describe the same partial window.”
  • S4-R2: “The Revenue tile headline is the total revenue for the selected range, shown as a dollar amount to the cent.”
  • S4-R11a: “On Revenue and the count tiles, a bucket with no sales is a point at 0. Only a ratio tile's "-" (S3-E3) contributes no point.”
  • S4-R11b: “The sparkline shows direction, not level. Each tile scales its line between its own lowest and highest point, so a figure that never changes over the range (for example Technician Utilization at 100% on every day) draws as a flat line along the bottom of the trend area, whatever the figure is. The headline carries the actual value. The start-at-0 axis of S9-R8 applies to the expanded and report charts, which have an axis, not to the sparkline.”
  • S4-E3: “A range where every point is zero except one shows the sparkline, because not every point is zero.”

Last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026.
